texts.title: The interview
texts.text: So, tell me about yourself. — I've been working as a project manager for four years. In my current job I'm responsible for a team of six people. — Why are you applying for this position? — I'd like to work on bigger international projects, and your company is known for them. — What would you say is your main strength? — I'm well organised and I can work under pressure. Last year our team delivered a big project two weeks early. — And your weaknesses? — Sometimes I try to do everything myself, but I'm learning to delegate more. — Great. What's your notice period? — One month.
